test_scenarios.description: Queries that should answer ONLY from uploaded document without touching VDB
test_scenarios.expected_behavior: Response comes exclusively from document text. VDB should not be queried. Logs should show: '📄 QUERY TYPE: DOCQA' and 'no VDB' or similar

queries.text: What are the key employee management practices and responsibilities mentioned in the document?
queries.expected_source: Document only - should cite specific sections about employment categories, work hours, benefits

queries.text: Hva er arbeidstidsordningen og fleksibilitetsprinsippene som nevnes i dokumentet?
queries.expected_source: Document only - should discuss 37.5 hours/week, flexible schedules, remote work policy

queries.text: What data protection and compliance measures are implemented in this company?
queries.expected_source: Document only - encryption, access controls, incident response procedures

queries.text: Hvilke sikkerhetstiltak og prosedyrer er dokumentert for håndtering av sensitiv informasjon?
queries.expected_source: Document only - multi-factor authentication, audit logging, breach protocol

queries.text: Summarize the company's employee rights and what benefits are offered to staff
queries.expected_source: Document only - salary, health insurance, pension, professional development

test_scenarios.scenario_name: ENRICHED VDB SEARCH - Document Summary + Query Enhancement
test_scenarios.description: Extract document summary, enrich user query with it, then search VDB for related statutes/guidance
test_scenarios.expected_behavior: System should extract document summary (about employee management/data protection), add keywords to user query, search Milvus VDB, return statute-related results with higher relevance than basic search

queries.text: Find legal guidance about employee management and work hour regulations for Norwegian companies
queries.enrichment_keywords: employee management, work hours, flexible schedules, employment practices
queries.expected_vdb_results: Should retrieve statutes related to employment law, working hours, labor regulations

queries.text: Hva sier norsk lovgivning om datavern og sikkerhetskrav i IT-selskaper?
queries.expected_vdb_results: Should find data protection, information security, and IT-related statutory requirements

queries.text: What are the legal requirements for workplace safety and hazard management in manufacturing facilities?
queries.enrichment_keywords: workplace safety, hazard management, machinery, protective equipment, incident reporting
queries.expected_vdb_results: Should retrieve workplace safety, equipment standards, occupational health statutes

queries.text: Hvilke lovkrav gjelder for finansiell rapportering og regnskap i Norge?
queries.enrichment_keywords: regnskap, finansiell rapportering, revisor, årsoppgjør, bokføring, revisjon
queries.expected_vdb_results: Should find accounting law, reporting requirements, auditor standards

queries.text: Find statutory regulations about tenant rights and landlord responsibilities
queries.enrichment_keywords: tenant rights, landlord obligations, lease agreements, property maintenance, dispute resolution
queries.expected_vdb_results: Should retrieve tenancy law, property management regulations, dispute procedures

test_scenarios.description: Answer by combining both document content and VDB-retrieved statute information
test_scenarios.expected_behavior: System should retrieve from both document and VDB, then generate unified answer comparing/citing both. Logs should show retrieval from both sources

queries.text: How does our company's employee policy compare to Norwegian employment law requirements?
Er vår arbeidsmiljøpolicy i samsvar med norske lovkrav for sikkerhet og helse?
queries.expected_answer_structure: Dokumentet sier [xyz], Loven krever [abc], Vurdering: [compliance status]

queries.text: What legal compliance gaps exist between our current financial procedures and Norwegian accounting regulations?
queries.expected_answer_structure: Our procedures: [xyz], Regulations require: [abc], Recommendations: [action items]

queries.text: Hva sier loven om leietakerrettigheter sammenlignet med våre leieavtaler?
Based on our company documentation and applicable law, what additional safeguards should we implement?
queries.expected_answer_structure: Current state: [xyz], Legal requirements: [abc], Recommended improvements: [list]

test_scenarios.description: Follow-up questions that rely on context from previous query to maintain conversation flow
test_scenarios.expected_behavior: System should recognize follow-up context, remember previous intent and results, continue from where it left off without re-answering earlier questions

queries.previous_query: What are the key employee management practices?
queries.text: Can you elaborate more on the remote work policy and how it's managed?
queries.expected_behavior: Reference previous answer about 3 days office/2 days remote, expand on management details

queries.text: Hvordan håndteres overtid og kompensasjon?
queries.expected_behavior: Continue from previous answer about work hours, focus on overtime compensation (1.5x or time off)

queries.previous_query: What workplace safety hazards are documented?
queries.text: What specific PPE is required for workers in the heat treatment area?
queries.expected_behavior: Reference previous safety discussion, focus on heat treatment specific equipment (fire-resistant aprons, face shield)

queries.text: Hvor ofte inspekteres maskiner og utstyr?
queries.expected_behavior: Continue from safety context, detail inspection schedule (daily, weekly, monthly, annual)

queries.previous_query: Explain the annual financial reporting process
queries.text: Who reviews these reports and what happens after the audit?
queries.expected_behavior: Follow up from previous answer about year-end closure, discuss auditor role, board presentation, filing to registry

scenario_1_docqa.check_1: Verify VDB is NOT queried (logs should show 'DOCQA' and 'document only')
scenario_1_docqa.check_2: Verify response comes from document text
scenario_1_docqa.check_3: Verify no 'Retrieved from VDB' or similar messages in output
scenario_1_docqa.check_4: Response should cite specific sections of document

scenario_2_enriched.check_2: Verify query is enriched with document keywords
scenario_2_enriched.check_3: Verify VDB is queried with enriched query
scenario_2_enriched.check_4: Results should be more relevant than basic keyword search

scenario_3_hybrid.check_1: Verify both document and VDB sources are used
scenario_3_hybrid.check_2: Answer includes comparisons between document and law
scenario_3_hybrid.check_4: Logs show both document loading AND VDB retrieval

scenario_4_followup.check_2: Verify continuation from previous query (not re-asking)
scenario_4_followup.check_4: Logs show history loading and follow-up classification
